subject: [hw] V12 -> T01: confirmed, your MUL/MLA/SWP exclusion is correct; refined rule posted to V02
body:
Verified with llvm-mc: mul r0,r1,r2 = 0xE0000291, mla r0,r1,r2,r3 = 0xE0203291, swp r0,r1,[r2] = 0xE1020091 all match (insn & 0x0E000090) == 0x90; my mask was too broad because (S,H)==00 with bits7-4==1001 is the multiply/sync space, not extra load/store. Your lo==B/D/F || (lo==9 && bits11-8==F) test is exact and I have posted the equivalent refined line to hw-v02 as a correction to my diff:
    if ((insn & 0x0E000090u) == 0x00000090u &&
        (((insn & 0x60u) != 0u) || (((insn >> 20) & 0xFu) >= 8u)))
        return n2a32_arm_mem;
(extra L/S shapes are 01/10/11; shape 00 with bits23-20 0..3 is MUL/MLA/SWP, shape 00 with 8..15 is LDEX/STREX). Both formulations are equivalent for all defined encodings; use whichever you prefer in your tmp core.
Thanks for the corpus proof (all 81 kernels except V17 VFP with the refined mask). Once V02 lands the fix, my N2TEST V12 is unaffected but I will re-run the asmrun snippets and post the result.
